description.narrative: ILAC arbetar med utveckling och reformer av nationella rättssystem, främst i länder drabbade av väpnade konflikt.
ILAC's aim is to improve the justice system, foremost in countries affected by violent conflict.

General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2016Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: The report from ILAC corresponds to extended core support during nine months April - Dec 2015. For conclusions from the (more elaborated) final report up until march 2015, see separate statement. The additional results in relation to the previous three year period are therefore limited. Organisational changes took place during this period and the original results framework was found less relevant at this stage, according to ILAC. ILAC reports results in relation to strengthening of their network and member organisations, their role as expert organisation on policy level in Sweden and internationally and initiatives and activities on country level, mostly pre-studies and also support to ongoing programs, funded by other Sida units. During 2016, i.e. after the period reviesed, ILAC has conducted two situation analyses in CAR and Syria respectively
